lines.text: Morning, Gareth. How's the back been since last time?
Since last time it's eased off a lot, I'm moving a bit better in the mornings.
Good. Any numbness down the legs?
Nope, no numbness or tingling at all, and no trouble going to the toilet.
Let me have a look at you bending forward. That's much freer than before, fingertips reach your shins now.
Keep up the walking, half an hour every day, and add the back extensions lying on your front, ten of them morning and night.
If you get pain shooting down both legs or any change with your bladder, ring us or go straight to A and E.
Will do. Thanks ever so much.
Right, Gareth, that's you all done, see you next week.
Hiya, come on in, you must be Wendy. Pop your bag down there.
Hello. It's my right shoulder, I can't get my arm above my head since I fell off a stepladder.
Ouch. Right, tell me when it happened.
